description: A single ex-Fuerza Aérea Guatemalteca light aircraft ("avioneta") mounted on the zona 12 roundabout leading to Cobán aerodrome; placed 13 Sep 2020 and inaugurated 15 Sep 2020 by the Municipalidad de Cobán as a tribute to the aviators of Alta Verapaz. CRN Noticias gives 60 quintales (~2;700 kg) and a 12 m wingspan; and reports vandals forced the rear cargo door within days. NEITHER source names the type. The published dimensions rule out the IAI Arava (20.9 m span) and are too large for a Cessna 206 (10.9 m); so a Cessna 208 Caravan; a PC-6 or a twin utility type are all live candidates — I am not guessing. manufacturer; model; variant; tail_number and model_name are all deliberately blank; aircraft_type/wing_type/military_civilian are recorded because "avioneta de la Fuerza Aérea Guatemalteca" establishes them.
museum_name: Monumento a los Pilotos Aviadores de Alta Verapaz
